$comment: Pins the .NET SDK so a local build, a CI build and a release build all use
the same compiler and the same SDK targets. Without this file the CI runner
silently uses whichever 10.0.x feature band the image happens to carry,
which is how a build that is green locally fails on the runner, or worse,
rollForward latestPatch: a newer patch of the 10.0.3xx band is accepted
(security fixes should not require a repo edit), a newer feature band is
not. Set dotnet-version in both workflows to the same version below.
